title: Find Users with High Token Usage
summary: For each user with at least three prompts, average their token counts; keep users with at least one token count strictly above their own unrounded average. Return user_id, prompt_count, avg_tokens rounded to two decimals, sorted by average descending then user_id ascending.
inputFormat: prompts(user_id int, prompt text, tokens int), primary key (user_id, prompt).
officialConstraints: user_id and tokens integers; prompt text; key (user_id, prompt).
tieRules: Sort avg_tokens descending then user_id ascending. Strictly-above comparison uses the unrounded average.
edgeRules: Filter uses the unrounded average, not the rounded value.
exampleStatus: authored-reference (validation only; not for publication as source examples)

factsPresent: at least one tokens value strictly above the user's average
